steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Open demo/ in Godot 4.3+ (mono) with the Godot Open MCP addon enabled and the bridge running. Your MCP client must point at this project. This is a read-only connectivity smoke — no fixtures are staged and no reset is required.

steps.title: Run ping in the MCP client
Expected outcomes
items: Response confirms the bridge is reachable (ping/health payload per the shipped godot_open_mcp_ping schema).
The setup-ping action log line also shows isError: false when the bridge is running.
With the bridge stopped, the tool surfaces an actionable error (isError: true) and the suite does not crash.
